blurb: This check confirms the AIX (or VIOS) Technology Level is current for its release and still inside its service-pack fix-support window. A box that lags the release latest Technology Level, or whose TL has passed its fix-support end date, is no longer receiving the defect and security fixes IBM publishes for the current TL, so newly disclosed CVEs can remain open. On a VIOS the underlying AIX level is a secondary signal behind the VIOS level.
